caption: The drawing features a single, metallic lidded bowl placed centrally on a plain, light background. The object has a rounded body with a slightly flared rim and a wide, tiered base. The lid is domed, fitting snugly onto the bowl, with a small, raised circular handle at its top. The shading and reflective highlights suggest a smooth, polished surface typical of metal, such as silver or stainless steel, rendered in grayscale. The background is unadorned except for minor marks and a small stain toward the lower left corner and another faint mark toward the bottom right, with a subtle gradient from a darker tone at the top to lighter at the bottom.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
